verse.verse_1: Noon. By the Pen and that (the angels) write,
verse.verse_2: you are not, because of the favor of your Lord, mad.
verse.verse_3: Indeed, there is an unfailing wage for you.
verse.verse_4: Surely, you (Prophet Muhammad) are of a great morality.
verse.verse_5: You shall see and they will see
verse.verse_6: which of you is the demented.
verse.verse_7: Indeed, your Lord knows very well those who strayed from His Path, and those who are guided.
verse.verse_8: Therefore, do not obey those who belie,
verse.verse_9: they wish you would compromise, then, they would compromise.
verse.verse_10: And do not obey every mean swearer,
verse.verse_11: the backbiter who goes about slandering,
verse.verse_12: those who hinder good, the guilty aggressor,
verse.verse_14: because he has wealth and sons.
verse.verse_15: When Our verses are recited to him, he says: 'They are but fairytales of the ancients'
verse.verse_16: We shall mark him upon his nose!
verse.verse_17: We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden who had sworn that in the morning they would reap it,
verse.verse_18: without adding to their swearing, (Allah willing, InshaAllah).
verse.verse_19: Then, a visitation from your Lord came down upon it while they slept,
verse.verse_20: and in the morning it was if the garden had been reaped.
verse.verse_21: (Then) in the morning they called out to one another, saying:
verse.verse_22: 'Come out to your tillage if you want to reap'
verse.verse_23: And so they departed, whispering to one another:
verse.verse_24: 'No needy person shall set foot in it today'
verse.verse_25: And they went out early, determined in their resolve.
verse.verse_26: But when they saw it they said: 'We have surely gone astray.
verse.verse_27: No, rather, we have been prevented'
verse.verse_28: (Whereupon) the best among them said: 'Did I not say to you to exalt (Allah)'
verse.verse_29: 'Exaltations to Allah, our Lord' they said, 'We were truly harmdoers'
verse.verse_30: And they came blaming one another.
verse.verse_31: They said 'Woe to us, truly we were insolent'
verse.verse_32: It may be that our Lord will give us better than it in exchange. To our Lord we humbly turn'
verse.verse_33: Such was their punishment. But the punishment of the Everlasting Life is much greater, if they but knew.
verse.verse_34: Surely, the cautious shall have Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.
verse.verse_35: What, shall We make those who are submissive like the wrongdoers?
verse.verse_36: What is the matter with you then, how do you judge?
verse.verse_37: Or, have you a Book from which you study
verse.verse_38: surely in it you shall have whatever you choose!
verse.verse_39: Or, have you an oath from Us that stretches to the Day of Resurrection (if so) you shall surely have what you judge!
verse.verse_40: Ask them, which of them will guarantee that!
verse.verse_41: Or, do they have associates? Then let them bring their associates, if what they say is true!
verse.verse_42: On the Day when the leg shall be bared, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves, they will be unable.
verse.verse_43: Their eyes will be humbled, and humiliation shall spread over them for they were already ordered to prostrate themselves when they were undiminished.
verse.verse_44: Therefore, leave Me with he who belied this discourse. We will draw them on little by little from where they do not know.
verse.verse_45: I shall respite them, My stratagem is firm.
verse.verse_46: Or, do you ask them for a wage, so that they are burdened withdebt?
verse.verse_47: Or, is the Unseen with them, and they are writing it down!
verse.verse_48: So be patient with the judgement of your Lord and do not be like the Companion of the Whale (Jonah), when he called out choking inwardly.
verse.verse_49: Had the favor of his Lord not come upon him, he would have been blamed, cast upon the shore.
verse.verse_50: But his Lord had chosen him and He placed him among the righteous.
verse.verse_51: When the unbelievers hear the Reminder, they nearly strike you down with their glances, and say: 'Surely, he is mad'
verse.verse_52: But it is nothing other than a Reminder for all the worlds.
